Senior Backend Engineer

We are a fast-growing fintech company revolutionizing digital payments across India. We are
looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Platform Engineering department.

Required Skills:
5-8 Years of experience with Node.js, Java (Core Java), and PostgreSQL.
Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, MS SQL, and Kubernetes (K8s).
Experience with AWS, Docker, and REST API design.
B.Tech or M.Tech in Computer Science required.
PMP certification is a plus.

Nice to Have:
Experience with GraphQL and MongoDB.
Familiarity with Terraform.

Responsibilities:
- Design and build scalable backend services
- Collaborate with product and design teams
- Mentor junior engineers
- Participate in on-call rotation

Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-time
Notice Period: 30 days
Openings: 3
Salary: 18-25 LPA
Languages: English, Hindi preferred.
